name: wds_vtab-eurosat
description: A Vision/VTAB-style subset built from the EuroSAT satellite imagery dataset for model evaluation in transfer and adaptation tasks. Measures how well models classify land-use/land-cover categories from aerial/satellite images, typically used to benchmark vision encoders under few-shot or standard finetuning settings.
reputation: Widely used as a standard remote-sensing/VTAB transfer task; commonly employed in representation- and transfer-learning evaluations.
